claim: In an Elabe July 2026 poll, an Attal/Philippe-vs-Le Pen presidential runoff shows Retailleau (LR) voters splitting only 4/10 to the presidential-camp candidate versus 5/10 to Le Pen.
stance_target: front républicain / barrage transfer coefficients have eroded on the right compared to 2024 legislative baseline
scope_conditions: France, hypothetical 2027 presidential second round, LR/Retailleau electorate
quoted_support: les électeurs de Bruno Retailleau seraient partagés : 4 sur 10 voteraient pour le candidat du camp présidentiel, 5 sur 10 pour Marine Le Pen.

claim: In a Mélenchon/Le Pen presidential runoff hypothesis, 7 in 10 Retailleau (LR) voters and 1 in 3 centrist voters would vote for Le Pen, while PS and centrist voters abstain massively (6 in 10).
stance_target: presidential-runoff transfer coefficients diverge sharply from the 2024 legislative front-républicain matrix depending on which candidate faces RN
scope_conditions: France, hypothetical 2027 presidential second round, Mélenchon vs Le Pen configuration
quoted_support: 1 électeurs du centre sur 3 et 7 électeurs de Bruno Retailleau sur 10 voteraient Marine Le Pen.

claim: Marine Le Pen would beat every tested 2027 presidential runoff opponent, from 52-48% against Edouard Philippe to 67.5-32.5% against Jean-Luc Mélenchon.
quoted_support: Marine Le Pen l'emporterait nettement face à Jean-Luc Mélenchon (67,5 vs 32,5%) [...] Marine Le Pen [...] devancerait, avec un écart plus resserré, Édouard Philippe (52 vs 48%).

claim: In Philippe/Attal-vs-Le Pen scenarios, the presidential-camp candidate gets only 4/10 transfer from Mélenchon voters versus 7/10 from Glucksmann voters, showing left-bloc transfer rates are not uniform but depend heavily on which left figure is the source electorate.
stance_target: a single fixed NFP-to-barrage transfer coefficient can be applied uniformly across all left subgroups
quoted_support: le candidat du camp présidentiel bénéficierait de très bons reports de voix à gauche (7 sur 10 de Raphaël Glucksmann, 4 sur 10 de Jean-Luc Mélenchon)

claim: Marine Le Pen would capture 1 in 5 (1 sur 5) LR voters in the first round against Edouard Philippe as an example of RN's erosion of the traditional right electorate even before any runoff transfer.
stance_target: erosion of the right's barrier against RN is visible even in first-round vote intention, not just second-round transfers
quoted_support: Marine Le Pen ferait quasiment le plein auprès des électeurs du Rassemblement National lors des élections législatives 2024 (84%), et capterait 1 électeur LR sur 5.
